1. **Family Variability Index (FVI)**: An integer index of variability for each position based on multiple sequence alignments of homologous families. FVI >= 5 indicates high family variability (+4 score component), FVI >= 3 indicates moderate family variability (+2 score component). FVI is used as a filter in [CandidateDiscoveryEngine](file:///C:/Bioinformatics/PETase_Engineering_Atlas_Development/PETase_Evolution/engine/candidate_discovery.py#L5).

4. **Family Consensus Residues**: The specific consensus amino acid for each family (e.g. `IsPETase-like_consensus`, `Thermobifida-like_consensus`, etc.). Proposed mutations must match at least one family consensus (via [FamilyConsensusGenerator](file:///C:/Bioinformatics/PETase_Engineering_Atlas_Development/PETase_Evolution/engine/proposal_generators/family_consensus_generator.py#L19)) to be recommended under evolutionary logic.

6. **Chemical Plausibility**: Classification of substitution as "Conservative" vs "Non-conservative" (based on properties of WT vs mutant residue). Conservative substitutions receive +1 in [ProposalScoringEngine](file:///C:/Bioinformatics/PETase_Engineering_Atlas_Development/PETase_Evolution/engine/proposal_scoring.py#L22).

7. **Sequence/Coordinate Alignment**: Pairwise sequence alignment (using BLOSUM62 global dynamic programming alignment against canonical reference `IsPETase_v1` sequence) to map positions from study sequence to Atlas database coordinates, performed by [ReferenceMapper](file:///C:/Bioinformatics/PETase_Engineering_Atlas_Development/PETase_Evolution/engine/reference_mapper.py#L21).

8. **Predicted Family Consensus Match**: Whether a proposed mutation at a mapped position matches the consensus of the predicted family (as classified by [FamilyClassifier](file:///C:/Bioinformatics/PETase_Engineering_Atlas_Development/PETase_Evolution/engine/family_classifier.py#L30)). Adds `"family_consensus_support"` tag if matching.
